assay: Oxford Nanopore PCR-cDNA long-read RNA-seq (MinION), minimap2 -> TranscriptClean -> TALON (S2.4.p1, S2.5.p2)
sample_inclusion: C57BL/6-Tg(TERT) mice ~10 weeks, gastrocnemius; 30-min treadmill run at 60% max speed (S2.2.p1)
terminal sampling: pre (3M 2F), immediately post (3M 2F), 1 h post (2M 3F), 24 h post (3M 2F); animals randomly assigned to time points, none excluded (S2.2.p1)
primary_estimand: Acute treadmill-exercise effect on gastrocnemius gene expression at each recovery time vs pre-exercise (S3.1.p2, FIG2F-H).

blocking_or_covariance.note: different animals at each time point (S2.2.p1)

matrix_scale: TALON read counts; known genes detected in at least half of the samples (S2.6.p2)
paper_method: Swan v2.0 gene-level differential expression (log2FC + adjusted p) (S2.6.p2)

paper_threshold.note: S3.1.p2 first applies |log2FC| > 1.5, p-adj < .05 and then a relaxed |log2FC| > 1.0, p-adj < .05 for figures 2F-H; the relaxed rule is kept as a labelled audit threshold

reported_counts.ipe_vs_pre: 23 (17 up, 6 down) at |log2FC|>1.5; 46 (33 up, 13 down) at |log2FC|>1.0; 6323 genes detected
reported_counts.1pe_vs_pre: 13 (9 up, 4 down) at 1.5; 32 (24 up, 8 down) at 1.0; 5459 genes detected
reported_counts.24pe_vs_pre: 31 (15 up, 16 down) at 1.5; 49 (23 up, 26 down) at 1.0; 6125 genes detected
reported_counts.validated: Ube2d1 up at ipe (log2FC 0.75), Fbxo32 up at 1pe (2.7), Fos down at 24pe (-3.9) (S3.1.p2)

enrichment: none at gene level for the mouse DGE (<80 significant genes, S2.6.p3)
